summary: Banco Bradesco filed a 6-K announcing a capital increase of up to BRL 10 billion (about $1.9 billion) via private subscription of shares, with controlling shareholders committing to subscribe up to BRL 8 billion. The board approved issuance of up to 302.9 million common and 302.0 million preferred shares at BRL 15.43 and BRL 17.64 per share, respectively, a 6% discount to market. Preemptive rights run from August 6 to September 4, 2026. Proceeds support strategic investments; the deal adds ~0.9 percentage points to the Common Equity Ratio. Watch subscription uptake and shareholder participation.
